components.name: Default Button
components.description: Standard rack button: raised fill, edge border.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:32px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid oklch(var(--edge)); background:oklch(var(--raised)); color:oklch(var(--ink)); font:500 13px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background:oklch(var(--line) / 0.7); } .ds-btn:active { background:oklch(var(--line)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(var(--signal)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-kbd { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:18px; min-width:18px; padding:0 4px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 30%, transparent); font:600 10px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; opacity:.8; }

components.name: Mosh Me Daddy
components.description: The one filled amber primary: new videos, effects, blend and mix.
components.css: .ds-mmd { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:300px; height:48px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:oklch(var(--signal)); color:oklch(var(--signal-ink)); font:600 15px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:filter 150ms; } .ds-mmd:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-mmd:active { filter:brightness(.95); } .ds-mmd:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(var(--signal)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-mmd-hint { margin-left:auto; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; opacity:.8; } .ds-mmd-kbd { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:18px; min-width:18px; padding:0 4px; border-radius:4px; border:1px solid color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 30%, transparent); font:600 10px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; opacity:.8; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Pressable switch; on state lights amber.
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; gap:6px; } .ds-toggle { height:28px; padding:0 8px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid oklch(var(--edge)); background:transparent; color:oklch(var(--dim)); font:500 12px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-toggle:hover { background:oklch(var(--raised)); color:oklch(var(--ink)); } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:oklch(var(--signal) / 0.5); background:oklch(var(--signal) / 0.15); color:oklch(var(--signal)); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(var(--signal)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Rack-well field; focus turns the border amber.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; width:280px; } .ds-field-label { font:500 12px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color:oklch(var(--dim)); } .ds-input { height:32px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid oklch(var(--edge)); background:oklch(var(--rack)); color:oklch(var(--ink)); font:400 13px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; caret-color:oklch(var(--signal)); transition:border-color 150ms; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:oklch(var(--signal)); } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:oklch(var(--danger)); }

components.name: Layer Chips
components.description: Channel identity: letter on layer colour.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:2px; color:oklch(var(--rack)); font:700 12px/1 'Saira Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: 44px panel face: wordmark, tempo, beat light, actions.

components.css: .ds-bar { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; height:44px; padding:0 12px; background:oklch(var(--panel)); border-bottom:1px solid oklch(var(--line)); color:oklch(var(--ink)); font-family:system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-wordmark { font:700 17px/1 'Saira Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-bpm { display:inline-flex; align-items:baseline; gap:4px; height:28px; padding:0 8px; align-items:center; border:1px solid oklch(var(--edge)); border-radius:6px; background:oklch(var(--rack)); font-size:11px; color:oklch(var(--dim)); } .ds-bpm b { font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:oklch(var(--ink)); } .ds-beat { display:flex; gap:4px; } .ds-beat i { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:oklch(var(--line)); } .ds-beat i.on { background:oklch(var(--signal)); } .ds-status { flex:1; font-size:13px; color:oklch(var(--dim)); } .ds-sep { width:1px; height:20px; background:oklch(var(--line)); } .ds-bar-btn { height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:oklch(var(--dim)); font:500 13px/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-bar-btn:hover { background:oklch(var(--raised)); color:oklch(var(--ink)); } .ds-bar-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(var(--signal)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.css: .ds-strip { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; width:216px; padding:8px; border-radius:6px; background:oklch(var(--raised)); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(var(--layer-a) / 0.6); color:oklch(var(--ink)); font:500 13px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-strip-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-chip-a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:20px; height:20px; border-radius:2px; background:oklch(var(--layer-a)); color:oklch(var(--rack)); font:700 12px/1 'Saira Semi Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-strip-body { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-thumb { flex:1; aspect-ratio:16/9; border-radius:2px; background:oklch(var(--rack)); } .ds-meter { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; width:6px; } .ds-meter i { flex:1; border-radius:1px; background:oklch(var(--layer-a)); opacity:.14; } .ds-meter i.peak { background:oklch(var(--signal)); } .ds-meter i.lit { opacity:1; } .ds-strip-foot { font-size:12px; color:oklch(var(--dim)); text-align:right; }

narrative.overview:
MOSHTUBE is a piece of VJ gear rendered in a browser tab: a matte graphite chassis with the stage cut into it, a row of channel strips along the bottom edge, and a single amber lamp that lights only when something is live, active, or the one thing to press. The output is the art. Everything around it is dark, flat, and quiet so the stage carries all the colour and motion on screen.

Density is that of hardware, not a dashboard: controls are compact (28 to 32px), grouped into strips and sections separated by hairlines rather than floated on cards. Labels are small uppercase condensed caps, like silkscreen printed on a faceplate; readouts are tabular numerals. Modulation is made visible the way a mixer shows it: per-strip LED meters, a four-step beat light, and amber markers that ride the live value of any oscillating slider.

The system refuses two things the build visibly avoids: the generic dark admin dashboard (sidebars of cards around a small video) and the near-black-plus-neon-glow costume. Nothing glows. Colour beyond graphite is either the amber signal or a layer identity colour, and each has a fixed job.
keyCharacteristics: Matte graphite in three surface steps (rack, panel, raised), separated by hairline dividers.
One amber signal colour for live, active, and primary; nothing else is amber.
Four layer identity colours (A blue, B rose, C lime, Master white) used as labels on the hardware, never as decoration.
Silkscreen labels in Saira Semi Condensed; everything else in the system UI sans with tabular numerals.
Modulation shown live: LED meters, beat light, amber value markers.
Flat at rest; soft shadow only on things that float above the rack.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber means live, active, or primary, and nothing else. If an element is amber it is either moving with the music, switched on, or the single action to press on that surface.

rules.name: The Labels-Not-Paint Rule
rules.body: Layer colours identify a channel; they never fill panels, buttons, or backgrounds. Chips, meters, and selection rings are the whole list.

rules.name: The Edge-Versus-Line Rule
rules.body: Anything you can operate gets an edge-coloured boundary (at least 3:1); a line-coloured hairline only divides and is never the sole outline of a control.

rules.name: The Silkscreen Rule
rules.body: Saira Semi Condensed is for labels printed on the gear (section and control-group names, the wordmark, layer letters). Running text, values, and buttons stay in the system sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number on screen uses tabular figures so readouts don't jitter while values move.

rules.name: The Flat Rack Rule
rules.body: Anything docked into the rack (bars, strips, sections, buttons) has no shadow. Only floating layers get one, and it is a soft dark drop, never a coloured glow.

dos: Do keep amber to live modulation, change pulses, focus, and the one primary action per surface; pressed toggles and active icon buttons stay neutral.
Do give every operable control an edge-coloured boundary or a raised fill; reserve line for dividers.
Do lead every channel with its layer chip and carry its layer colour into its meter and selection ring.
Do set section and control-group names as 11px uppercase Saira labels in dim, and everything else in the system sans.
Do show modulation live: a meter, a beat lamp, or an amber marker on the value that moves.
Do keep transitions to 150ms colour changes and 300ms fades for status and the overlay pill; no page-load choreography.
Do keep the stage the largest region and leave it unobstructed outside fullscreen.
donts: Don't use glows, neon edge light, or coloured shadows; shadows are soft dark drops on floating layers only.
Don't use soft decorative gradients on chrome; hard-stop splits that draw a physical detail (the fader cap centre line) are fine, and the stage output is exempt.
Don't put layer colours on panels, button fills, text blocks, or backgrounds.
Don't add a second filled amber button to the main mixer or phone view; Mosh Me Daddy is the primary.
Don't wrap controls in floating cards with shadows around a small video; strips sit flush in the rack.
Don't use line (1.43:1) as the only boundary of an interactive control.
